About.heading: About Me
About.bio:
I'm a Software Engineer with over six years of experience designing and delivering enterprise-grade applications. My focus has been on the intersection of security and scalability — building systems that handle millions of transactions while protecting sensitive data through digital signatures, certificate management, and multi-layered authentication.

At ISA Interfase, I've led the development of digital identity platforms from the ground up. I architected authentication services powered by OAuth2 and JWT, integrated Hardware Security Modules for cryptographic operations, and designed REST APIs that serve thousands of concurrent users. The work involves deep understanding of PKI, certificate lifecycle management, and secure communication protocols — the kind of challenges where getting it wrong isn't an option.

I'm equally comfortable on the frontend, building responsive interfaces with React and Angular that make complex security workflows intuitive for end users. My full-stack perspective means I design APIs with the UI in mind, and I build UIs that respect the constraints of distributed systems.

Beyond the code, I care about developer experience and team efficiency. I've set up CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins and Docker that reduced deployment time by 70%, and I advocate for clean architecture patterns that make codebases maintainable as teams grow. Currently, I'm deepening my expertise in cloud infrastructure and distributed systems, with a long-term interest in game development as a creative outlet that sharpens my systems thinking.

Projects.heading: Featured Projects
Projects.subheading: Enterprise applications I've architected and delivered

items.name: ISCERT
items.description: Enterprise platform for digital identity management, authentication, certificate lifecycle, and electronic signatures. A comprehensive solution that enables organizations to issue, manage, and verify digital certificates at scale.
items.problem: Organizations in regulated industries needed a centralized platform to manage digital identities, issue cryptographic certificates, and execute legally binding electronic signatures — all while maintaining compliance with strict security standards and providing a seamless user experience across web and mobile interfaces.
items.architecture: Built on a Spring Boot microservices backbone with PostgreSQL for transactional data. Authentication flows use OAuth2 with JWT tokens, backed by Hardware Security Modules (HSM) for cryptographic operations. The React frontend communicates through a secured API gateway with request validation at every layer.
challenges: Ensuring cryptographic operations comply with FIPS 140-2 standards while maintaining sub-second response times.
Designing certificate revocation lists (CRLs) that propagate across distributed services without compromising security.
Building an intuitive UI for complex PKI workflows that non-technical users can navigate confidently.

items.name: MiRecibo
items.description: Digital payroll signing platform with role-based access control and multi-tenant company configuration. Enables organizations to digitally sign and securely store payroll documents at scale.
items.problem: Companies needed a secure, auditable way to digitally sign payroll documents in bulk while managing complex organizational hierarchies — different roles have different signing and viewing permissions, and each company has its own configuration requirements for document templates and approval workflows.
items.architecture: Spring Boot backend with role-based authorization using Spring Security. Digital signatures are applied via HSM-backed cryptographic operations. PostgreSQL stores document metadata and audit trails, while the actual signed documents are stored in encrypted object storage. React frontend with dynamic form generation based on company-specific configurations.
challenges: Implementing granular role-based access that supports custom permission matrices per company without performance degradation.
Handling bulk signing operations for thousands of documents while providing real-time progress feedback to users.

items.name: FirmaPDF
items.description: Mass PDF digital signing platform with external authentication service integration. Designed for high-throughput environments where thousands of PDFs need to be signed with legally valid digital signatures.
items.problem: Enterprises generating large volumes of PDF documents needed a solution to apply digital signatures at scale — think thousands of invoices, contracts, or reports per day — while integrating with existing identity providers and ensuring each signature is cryptographically verifiable and legally binding.
items.architecture: The platform integrates with external OAuth2 identity providers for user authentication. PDF signing operations are queued and processed asynchronously using a message queue pattern, allowing the system to handle spikes in demand. Spring Boot services handle the actual cryptographic signing, and PostgreSQL tracks the status and metadata of every operation.
challenges: Processing thousands of concurrent signing requests without overwhelming HSM resources through intelligent queuing and batching.
Integrating with multiple external authentication providers, each with different token formats and validation requirements.

items.name: Magento Billing Plugin
items.description: Custom Magento plugin for automated billing process management. Streamlined recurring invoicing, subscription handling, and payment gateway integration for e-commerce clients.
items.problem: E-commerce clients using Magento needed automated recurring billing and subscription management beyond the platform's built-in capabilities.
items.architecture: PHP-based Magento plugin with MySQL backend, integrating third-party payment gateways and shipping APIs.
challenges: Automating recurring billing workflows within Magento's plugin architecture constraints.
Integrating multiple third-party payment gateways with zero-downtime deployments.

items.name: Web Analytics & Tracking
items.description: Implementation of Google Analytics and Google Tag Manager tracking infrastructure across DIRECTV's web properties, enabling data-driven marketing decisions through custom dashboards and automated reporting.
items.problem: DIRECTV needed comprehensive tracking across multiple websites to understand user behavior, measure campaign performance, and generate actionable business intelligence.
items.architecture: Google Analytics and Tag Manager deployed across multiple client websites with custom event tracking. Laravel (Lumen) APIs for data aggregation and Excel-based automated reporting pipelines.

Automating report generation to eliminate 15+ hours of weekly manual data entry.

items.name: WordPress Corporate Site
items.description: Maintenance and evolution of DIRECTV's corporate WordPress website. New pages, commercial campaign components, and performance optimization for production environments.
items.problem: DIRECTV's corporate site required ongoing evolution — new campaign pages, feature enhancements, bug fixes, and performance optimization — while maintaining stability in production.
items.architecture: WordPress CMS with custom PHP development for new functionality. HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for frontend components. Third-party plugin integration and maintenance.
challenges: Balancing rapid campaign deployments with production stability and performance.
Integrating and maintaining third-party plugins while ensuring compatibility across updates.

items.name: Crowdfunding Platform
items.description: Modern crowdfunding platform inspired by Kickstarter, built with a microservices architecture. A personal project that showcases full-stack capabilities from infrastructure to UI.
items.problem: Most crowdfunding platforms are monolithic, making it difficult to scale specific features independently or experiment with new functionality. I wanted to build a platform that demonstrates how a microservices approach can solve these problems while providing a clean, modern user experience.
items.architecture: Microservices architecture with Spring Boot services for campaigns, users, payments, and notifications — each with its own database. Services communicate via REST APIs with JWT-based authentication. PostgreSQL for transactional data. Docker Compose for local development. React frontend with a clean, responsive design.
challenges: Managing distributed transactions across campaign creation, payment processing, and notification services without a distributed transaction coordinator.
Designing a service decomposition that balances autonomy with practical development velocity for a solo project.

ProfessionalProfile.heading: Professional Profile
ProfessionalProfile.subheading: What I bring to the table
ProfessionalProfile.summary:
I am a Full Stack Developer with a strong specialization in Backend using Java and Spring Boot, complementing my experience with Frontend development using React and Angular with TypeScript.

Throughout my professional career I have participated in the design, development, maintenance, and evolution of enterprise applications, working primarily under microservices architectures and developing REST and SOAP APIs for system integration. I have experience implementing authentication mechanisms using JWT and Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), as well as documenting services with Swagger/OpenAPI to facilitate consumption and maintenance.

In Backend development I use Spring Boot with JPA for data access, implementing good design practices, centralized error handling through Controller Advice, and custom exceptions — building robust, maintainable, and scalable applications.

I regularly work with PostgreSQL and MySQL databases, writing SQL queries and modeling data structures according to each project's needs.

I also have experience with Docker for application containerization and Jenkins for implementing Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) processes, automating the build and release of new versions.

I have participated in deployments on Linux servers, managing Java applications running as services via systemd (systemctl), working in environments where WildFly and Nginx were part of the production infrastructure. Personally, I have also deployed applications on Amazon Web Services (AWS), primarily using EC2 instances.

I have knowledge of microservices-based architectures, inter-service communication, and service discovery using Eureka. I am currently expanding my knowledge by incorporating Apache Kafka for asynchronous communication between microservices, as well as observability and metrics tools for application monitoring.

Within the information security area, I gained specialized experience working with Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), Certificate Authorities (CA), issuance and revocation of digital certificates, use of HSM devices for secure generation of cryptographic key pairs, and digital document signing solutions.

In the quality area, I perform functional testing using Postman, load testing with JMeter, and develop applications incorporating WebSockets for real-time information updates.

I have worked under Agile Scrum methodologies, actively participating in Daily Scrum, Sprint Planning, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives, collaborating in the technical definition of user stories, task estimation, and two-week sprint planning.

During development I use Jira for task management and Confluence for technical documentation, architectures, deployment procedures, and environment setup. I have also collaborated in resolving production incidents by analyzing logs obtained together with Infrastructure and IT teams to identify root causes of errors and propose solutions.

I consider myself a problem-solving oriented person, with a facility for learning new technologies and a strong commitment to software quality, good development practices, and continuous improvement.
